refutes.claim: The README says the surrogate 'is only read at compile time and is never instantiated', and its example surrogate has no [MessagePackObject]. The code requires [MessagePackObject] on the surrogate (it reports TypeMustBeMessagePackObject and generates nothing otherwise), requires an accessible parameterless constructor, and instantiates the surrogate at run time through GetSurrogateConversionCode. Copying the documented example therefore gives a compile error and no formatter. The attribute's own XML doc says the opposite of the README.
